This page will collect publications, working papers, policy notes, datasets, and other research outputs associated with TIDE Lab.

## Coming next

The publication list will be added after member profiles and the lab's inclusion policy are confirmed. Each record can include the authors, year, abstract, publication status, DOI, replication materials, and a link to the paper.

::: {.tide-note}
No publications are attributed to TIDE Lab in this initial release. This avoids assigning existing work to the lab before the team confirms the appropriate scope.
:::
